information-processing.name: ChatGPT
information-processing.pitch: General-purpose AI assistant for text processing, summarization, data extraction, and Q&A.
information-processing.bestFor: Ad-hoc information lookup, document summarization, data extraction from unstructured text. Works across virtually all knowledge work tasks. The $8/mo Go tier sits between Free and Plus for light daily users; Plus adds the thinking models and the Codex coding agent.
information-processing.limitations: Can hallucinate facts. Free and Go tiers run smaller models with lower file-upload, image and deep-research allowances. Pro is now split into two price points ($100 and $200/mo) with different usage allowances, so confirm which one you are buying.

information-processing.name: Claude
information-processing.pitch: AI assistant with strong document analysis, long-context processing, and careful reasoning.
information-processing.bestFor: Analyzing long documents (up to 200K tokens), careful data extraction, tasks requiring nuanced judgment. Particularly strong at following complex instructions.
information-processing.limitations: No web browsing in free tier. No image generation. Slower than some alternatives for simple tasks.

information-processing.name: Microsoft Copilot (M365)
information-processing.pricing: Paid ($30/user/mo enterprise add-on; $21/user/mo for orgs under 300 seats)
information-processing.pitch: AI assistant embedded in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Teams.
information-processing.bestFor: Workers already in the Microsoft ecosystem. Automates document drafting, email triage, meeting summaries, Excel formula generation, and PowerPoint creation from within the tools people already use.
information-processing.limitations: Requires M365 E3/E5 subscription plus Copilot add-on. Quality varies by application (strong in Word/Outlook, weaker in Excel for complex analysis). Enterprise rollout requires admin configuration.

information-processing.name: Google Gemini (Workspace)
information-processing.pricing: Included with Workspace ($7/user/mo Starter, limited AI; $14/user/mo Standard for full Gemini)
information-processing.pitch: AI assistant embedded in Gmail, Docs, Sheets, Slides, and Meet.
information-processing.bestFor: Google Workspace users. Email drafting, document summarization, spreadsheet formulas, presentation creation, meeting notes.
information-processing.limitations: Tightly coupled to Google ecosystem. Less capable than standalone models for complex reasoning. Enterprise features require higher-tier plans.

information-processing.name: Docsumo
information-processing.pricing: Paid ($299/mo Starter for 1,000 pages, $799/mo Growth for 5,000; 14-day free trial)
information-processing.pitch: Intelligent document processing for invoices, receipts, bank statements, and financial documents.
information-processing.bestFor: High-volume document processing in accounting, finance, and operations. Extracts structured data from invoices, purchase orders, and financial statements with high accuracy.
information-processing.limitations: Expensive for small teams. Requires training period for custom document types. Best ROI at 500+ documents/month.

information-processing.name: Automation Anywhere
information-processing.pitch: Enterprise RPA platform for automating repetitive digital tasks across applications.
information-processing.bestFor: Large organizations with high-volume, rule-based processes across multiple systems (ERP, CRM, legacy apps). Automates data entry, form filling, cross-system data migration.
information-processing.limitations: Significant implementation cost and time. Requires dedicated RPA developers. Brittle when underlying applications change their UI. Overkill for small teams.

communication.name: Grammarly
communication.pitch: AI writing assistant for grammar, clarity, tone, and style across all writing surfaces.
communication.bestFor: Professionals who write frequently (emails, reports, proposals). Works as a browser extension, desktop app, and integrates with most writing tools. Tone detection helps match communication style to audience.
communication.limitations: Premium features require subscription. Can be overly prescriptive about style. The AI rewrite suggestions sometimes strip voice/personality from writing.

communication.name: Jasper
communication.pitch: AI content platform for marketing copy, blog posts, social media, and brand-consistent writing.
communication.bestFor: Marketing teams and content creators who need high-volume, brand-consistent copy. Template library covers ads, emails, product descriptions, blog posts. Brand voice training keeps output on-brand.
communication.limitations: Expensive for solo users. Output quality varies, needs human editing. Not great for technical or highly specialized writing.

communication.name: Otter.ai
communication.pitch: Real-time meeting transcription, summarization, and action item extraction.
communication.bestFor: Professionals in meeting-heavy roles. Auto-joins Zoom/Teams/Meet calls, generates transcripts with speaker identification, extracts action items, and creates shareable summaries.
communication.limitations: Accuracy drops with heavy accents, overlapping speakers, or poor audio. Free tier limited to 300 minutes/month. Requires calendar integration for auto-join.

communication.name: Loom
communication.pricing: Freemium ($18/user/mo for Business; AI features require Business + AI at $24/user/mo)
communication.pitch: Async video messaging with AI-powered summaries, chapters, and transcripts.
communication.bestFor: Replacing status update meetings with async video. Record screen + camera, AI generates summary and chapters. Viewers can watch at 2x or just read the summary.
communication.limitations: Not a replacement for interactive discussions. Video fatigue is real. Free tier limited to 25 videos and 5 min each.

communication.name: Gamma
communication.pitch: AI-powered presentation and document builder that generates polished decks from text prompts.
communication.bestFor: Creating presentations quickly without design skills. Takes text input or outlines and generates visually polished slides. Good for internal presentations, pitch decks, and reports.
communication.limitations: The free plan grants 400 AI credits once at signup and they do not refresh, so sustained use requires a paid plan. Paid tiers meter monthly credits (1,000 on Plus, 4,000 on Pro, 20,000 on Ultra). Limited customization compared to PowerPoint/Keynote. Templates can feel samey. Not ideal for highly branded or pixel-perfect presentations. The intermediate Pro price is reported inconsistently across sources ($18-$25/mo), so confirm at checkout.

analysis-decision.name: Perplexity AI
analysis-decision.pitch: AI-powered research assistant that searches the web and synthesizes answers with citations.
analysis-decision.bestFor: Research-heavy roles that need current, cited information. Replaces the "open 15 tabs and read them all" workflow. Pro tier includes academic paper search and file analysis.
analysis-decision.limitations: Citations are not always perfectly matched to claims. Free tier caps Pro Searches to a handful per day. Can miss niche or specialized sources. Not a replacement for deep domain expertise. Max at $200/mo is a big step up from Pro and only worth it for sustained deep-research volume.

analysis-decision.name: Tableau (with AI)
analysis-decision.pricing: Paid ($75/user/mo for Creator, billed annually; $42 Explorer, $15 Viewer)
analysis-decision.pitch: Business intelligence platform with AI-powered natural language queries and automated insights.
analysis-decision.bestFor: Analysts and managers who need to explore data visually. Ask Tableau questions in plain English, get charts. AI suggests relevant visualizations and highlights anomalies.
analysis-decision.limitations: Steep learning curve for advanced features. Expensive per-seat. Requires clean, well-structured data sources.

analysis-decision.name: Julius AI
analysis-decision.pricing: Freemium (free tier ~15 messages/mo; $20/mo for Plus, $45/mo for Pro)
analysis-decision.pitch: AI data analyst that processes spreadsheets, creates visualizations, and runs statistical analyses from natural language.
analysis-decision.bestFor: Non-technical professionals who need data analysis without coding. Upload a CSV, ask questions, get charts and statistical summaries. Handles regression, correlation, trend analysis.
analysis-decision.limitations: Limited to tabular data. Complex multi-step analyses can produce incorrect results. Not suitable for production data pipelines.

analysis-decision.name: Notion AI
analysis-decision.pricing: Bundled into Notion Business ($20/member/mo); trial-only AI on Free and Plus
analysis-decision.pitch: AI features built into Notion's workspace: summarize pages, extract action items, generate content, answer questions across your workspace.
analysis-decision.bestFor: Teams already using Notion for documentation. AI can search across your entire workspace to answer questions, summarize meeting notes, draft project briefs, and extract insights from existing docs.
analysis-decision.limitations: Only useful if your team's knowledge is in Notion. Quality depends heavily on how well-organized your workspace is. Add-on cost on top of existing Notion subscription.

analysis-decision.name: Power BI (with Copilot)
analysis-decision.pricing: Paid ($14/user/mo for Pro, $24.99/user/mo for Premium Per User; Copilot requires PPU or Fabric capacity)
analysis-decision.pitch: Microsoft's BI platform with AI-powered natural language queries, automated report generation, and anomaly detection.
analysis-decision.bestFor: Organizations in the Microsoft ecosystem. Ask data questions in plain English, auto-generate reports, detect outliers. Integrates natively with Excel, Azure, and Dynamics.
analysis-decision.limitations: Copilot features require Premium capacity (expensive). DAX formula language has a steep learning curve. Best with Microsoft data sources.

creative-generative.name: Midjourney
creative-generative.pricing: Paid ($10/mo Basic, $30 Standard, $60 Pro, $120 Mega; 20% off annual)
creative-generative.pitch: AI image generation with exceptional aesthetic quality, accessed via Discord or web interface.
creative-generative.bestFor: Concept art, marketing visuals, mood boards, social media imagery. Produces consistently beautiful results with relatively simple prompts. Strong at photorealistic and artistic styles. The web app is now the primary interface — Discord is optional.
creative-generative.limitations: No free tier or trial. Fast GPU hours are the real constraint: 3.3/mo on Basic, 15 on Standard, 30 on Pro, 60 on Mega. Limited control over precise details. Not great for text-in-image, technical diagrams, or exact brand specifications. Prices confirmed from multiple independent trackers — the vendor plan page is behind a checkout redirect and is not directly readable.

creative-generative.name: Canva (Magic Studio)
creative-generative.pricing: Freemium ($18/mo Pro, or $180/yr; Business billed per seat)
creative-generative.pitch: Design platform with AI-powered image generation, background removal, text-to-design, and brand kit management.
creative-generative.bestFor: Non-designers who need professional-looking visuals. Social media posts, presentations, flyers, marketing materials. AI features handle resizing, background removal, and style suggestions.
creative-generative.limitations: Pro has risen twice since 2025 ($12.99 to $15 to $18/mo), and the flat-rate Teams plan is now per-seat Canva Business, so team costs scale with headcount. Templates can look generic. Advanced design needs still require Figma/Adobe. AI image generation quality below Midjourney. Pro price confirmed from multiple independent trackers — canva.com blocks automated fetches.

creative-generative.name: Adobe Firefly
creative-generative.pricing: Standalone $9.99/mo Standard, $19.99 Pro, $49.99 Pro Plus, $199.99 Premium; bundled via Creative Cloud Pro ($69.99/mo)
creative-generative.pitch: AI image generation and editing integrated into Photoshop, Illustrator, and Express. Trained on licensed content.
creative-generative.bestFor: Creative professionals already in the Adobe ecosystem. Generative Fill in Photoshop, text-to-image, style transfer. Commercially safe (trained on Adobe Stock and licensed content).
creative-generative.limitations: The old $5 standalone entry point is gone — Firefly Standard now starts at $9.99/mo. Adobe split all-apps into Creative Cloud Standard ($54.99/mo) and Pro ($69.99/mo), with the full generative feature set only on Pro. Image quality below Midjourney for artistic work. Prices confirmed from multiple independent trackers; adobe.com blocks automated fetches.

creative-generative.name: Cursor
creative-generative.pitch: AI-native code editor (VS Code fork) with inline code generation, multi-file editing, and codebase-aware chat.
creative-generative.bestFor: Software developers of all levels. Write code from natural language descriptions, refactor across files, debug with AI assistance. Understands your full codebase context.
creative-generative.limitations: Subscription cost on top of existing tools. Can suggest incorrect code that compiles but has logic errors. Heavy reliance can slow down learning for junior developers.

creative-generative.name: Suno
creative-generative.pricing: Freemium ($10/mo for Pro, $8/mo billed annually; $30/mo for Premier)
creative-generative.pitch: AI music generation from text prompts. Creates full songs with vocals, instruments, and production.
creative-generative.bestFor: Content creators needing background music, jingles, or podcast intros. Marketing teams creating audio content. Rapid prototyping of musical ideas.
creative-generative.limitations: Output quality is impressive but not professional studio quality. Limited control over arrangement details. Licensing terms vary by plan.

creative-generative.name: Descript
creative-generative.pricing: Freemium ($16/person/mo Hobbyist, $24 Creator, $50 Business; annual billing)
creative-generative.pitch: AI-powered video and audio editing through text-based editing. Edit video by editing the transcript.
creative-generative.bestFor: Content creators, podcasters, and marketing teams. Edit video/audio by editing text, remove filler words automatically, generate clips, add captions. Dramatically lowers the skill bar for video production.
creative-generative.limitations: Complex edits still need traditional editors. AI voice cloning requires careful ethical use. Export quality can vary.

coordination-management.name: Reclaim.ai
coordination-management.pitch: AI scheduling assistant that auto-schedules tasks, habits, meetings, and breaks around your calendar.
coordination-management.bestFor: Professionals with overloaded calendars. Automatically finds time for focus work, 1:1s, and habits. Defends time blocks and reschedules when conflicts arise.
coordination-management.limitations: Requires Google Calendar or Outlook. Works best when you commit to letting it manage your schedule. Team features require everyone to be on the platform.

coordination-management.name: Motion
coordination-management.pricing: Paid ($19/seat/mo for Pro AI annual, $29/seat/mo for Business AI)
coordination-management.pitch: AI project manager that auto-schedules tasks, prioritizes work, and reschedules dynamically as priorities shift.
coordination-management.bestFor: Small teams and solo operators who need project management without the overhead. Add tasks with deadlines, Motion figures out when to do them. Auto-reschedules when you fall behind.
coordination-management.limitations: Monthly cost adds up for teams. Learning to trust the AI scheduler takes adjustment. Limited integrations compared to Asana/Monday.

coordination-management.name: Clockwise
coordination-management.pitch: AI calendar optimization that creates focus time blocks and streamlines meeting scheduling across teams.
coordination-management.bestFor: Teams drowning in meetings. Analyzes calendar patterns, consolidates meetings to create focus time blocks, and finds optimal meeting times across time zones.
coordination-management.limitations: Most valuable features require team-wide adoption. Free tier is limited. Works best with Google Calendar.

coordination-management.name: Asana (with AI)
coordination-management.pitch: Project management platform with AI features for status updates, task recommendations, and workflow optimization.
coordination-management.bestFor: Teams managing complex projects with multiple workstreams. AI generates status reports from task updates, recommends task assignments, and identifies bottlenecks.
coordination-management.limitations: Can become bloated for simple projects. AI features are relatively new and still maturing. Requires consistent team adoption to be useful.

coordination-management.name: Zapier (with AI)
coordination-management.pitch: No-code automation platform connecting 6,000+ apps with AI-powered workflow building.
coordination-management.bestFor: Automating repetitive cross-app workflows without coding. "When X happens in app A, do Y in app B." AI assistant helps build automations from natural language descriptions.
coordination-management.limitations: Complex automations can be fragile. Per-task pricing adds up at scale. Debugging failed automations requires understanding the workflow logic.

physical-manual.name: Fieldwire
physical-manual.pitch: Construction management platform for task tracking, plan markup, and field reporting.
physical-manual.bestFor: Construction managers and field supervisors. Digital plan markup, punch lists, daily reports, and photo documentation from job sites. Reduces paperwork and improves communication between field and office.
physical-manual.limitations: Adoption requires training field crews on mobile devices. Most valuable for commercial construction, less for small residential jobs. Requires reliable connectivity.

physical-manual.name: Procore
physical-manual.pricing: Enterprise (quote-only; priced on annual construction volume)
physical-manual.pitch: Construction management platform with AI-powered risk prediction, quality tracking, and safety compliance.
physical-manual.bestFor: Large construction firms managing multiple projects. AI analyzes project data to predict delays, identify safety risks, and flag quality issues before they become problems.
physical-manual.limitations: Enterprise pricing is significant. Implementation takes months. Overkill for small contractors.

physical-manual.name: Augmentir
physical-manual.pitch: AI-powered connected worker platform for manufacturing, with digital work instructions and skills management.
physical-manual.bestFor: Manufacturing and maintenance operations. AI personalizes work instructions based on worker skill level, identifies training gaps, and provides real-time guidance on complex procedures.
physical-manual.limitations: Requires significant upfront investment in deployment and content creation. Most valuable at scale (50+ workers). Needs reliable shop-floor connectivity.

physical-manual.name: SafetyCulture (iAuditor)
physical-manual.pricing: Freemium ($24/user/mo for Premium, billed annually; $29 monthly)
physical-manual.pitch: Inspection and audit platform with AI-powered issue detection, reporting, and compliance tracking.
physical-manual.bestFor: Any role requiring regular inspections (safety, quality, compliance). Digital checklists, photo evidence, automatic report generation. AI suggests corrective actions based on inspection findings.
physical-manual.limitations: Template setup requires initial effort. Best ROI for teams doing 10+ inspections/week. Free tier limited to 3 users.

interpersonal.name: Gong
interpersonal.pricing: Enterprise (quote only; per-user licenses plus a platform fee)
interpersonal.pitch: Revenue intelligence platform that records, transcribes, and analyzes customer calls and meetings.
interpersonal.bestFor: Sales teams and account managers. AI analyzes conversation patterns, identifies winning behaviors, flags risk signals in deals, and provides coaching recommendations based on actual call data.
interpersonal.limitations: Expensive. Requires buy-in from the entire sales org. Privacy concerns in some jurisdictions require disclosure. Most valuable with 10+ reps.

interpersonal.name: Crystal
interpersonal.pitch: AI personality assessment tool that predicts communication styles and provides tailored messaging suggestions.
interpersonal.bestFor: Sales, recruiting, and relationship management. Analyzes LinkedIn profiles and other public data to predict DISC personality type. Suggests how to write emails, conduct meetings, and negotiate with each person.
interpersonal.limitations: Personality predictions from public data have inherent accuracy limits. Can feel intrusive. Best as a preparation aid, not a substitute for genuine relationship skills.

interpersonal.name: Lavender
interpersonal.pitch: AI email coaching for sales outreach. Scores emails in real-time and suggests improvements for response rates.
interpersonal.bestFor: Sales development reps and anyone doing cold outreach. Analyzes email tone, length, readability, and personalization. Provides a score and specific suggestions before you send.
interpersonal.limitations: Optimizes for response rate, which isn't always the right metric. Can encourage formulaic writing. Most useful for high-volume outreach, less for relationship-based selling.

interpersonal.name: Fireflies.ai
interpersonal.pitch: Meeting assistant that records, transcribes, and generates summaries with action items and sentiment analysis.
interpersonal.bestFor: Client-facing professionals who need to be fully present in conversations instead of taking notes. Auto-captures everything, generates searchable transcripts, and tracks action items across meetings.
interpersonal.limitations: Requires participant consent for recording. Accuracy varies with audio quality. Sentiment analysis should be treated as directional, not definitive.

technical-specialized.name: GitHub Copilot
technical-specialized.pitch: AI pair programmer that suggests code completions, generates functions, and explains code inline in your IDE.
technical-specialized.bestFor: Software developers at all levels. Auto-completes code, generates boilerplate, writes tests, and explains unfamiliar code. Works in VS Code, JetBrains, Neovim, and more.
technical-specialized.limitations: Can suggest insecure or incorrect code. Doesn't understand full project architecture. Works best for common patterns, less reliable for novel or domain-specific logic.

technical-specialized.name: Casetext (CoCounsel)
technical-specialized.pricing: Enterprise (quote-only, sold as a Westlaw add-on)
technical-specialized.pitch: AI legal research assistant that reviews documents, identifies relevant case law, and drafts legal memos.
technical-specialized.bestFor: Lawyers and legal professionals. Analyze contracts, research case law, draft discovery responses, summarize depositions. Dramatically reduces time on legal research.
technical-specialized.limitations: Requires legal expertise to verify outputs. Cannot replace attorney judgment on strategy. Enterprise pricing limits accessibility for solo practitioners.

technical-specialized.name: Elicit
technical-specialized.pitch: AI research assistant for finding, reading, and synthesizing academic papers.
technical-specialized.bestFor: Researchers, analysts, and anyone who needs to synthesize academic literature. Searches across 200M+ papers, extracts key findings, identifies methodology, and creates structured summaries.
technical-specialized.limitations: Academic papers only (not industry reports, news, etc.). Extraction accuracy varies with paper complexity. Best for English-language research.

technical-specialized.name: Fathom (Financial)
technical-specialized.pricing: Paid (from ~$50/mo for Starter; tiers scale with entities connected)
technical-specialized.pitch: AI-powered financial reporting and analysis tool that generates narrative reports from accounting data.
technical-specialized.bestFor: Accountants and financial advisors. Connects to Xero, QuickBooks, or MYOB and generates visual reports, KPI dashboards, and narrative commentary. Turns numbers into client-ready reports.
technical-specialized.limitations: Only works with supported accounting platforms. Narrative generation is template-based, not fully AI-generated. Most valuable for firms with 10+ clients.

technical-specialized.name: Harvey AI
technical-specialized.pitch: AI platform purpose-built for legal work: contract analysis, due diligence, regulatory research, and litigation support.
technical-specialized.bestFor: Law firms and corporate legal departments. Handles complex legal reasoning, multi-jurisdictional research, and large-scale document review. Used by elite firms (Allen & Overy, PwC).
technical-specialized.limitations: Enterprise-only pricing. Requires firm-wide deployment and training. Best for large firms with high-volume, complex work.

technical-specialized.name: Dbt (with AI)
technical-specialized.pitch: Data transformation tool with AI-powered SQL generation, documentation, and lineage tracking.
technical-specialized.bestFor: Data engineers and analytics engineers. AI generates SQL transformations from natural language, auto-documents models, and explains complex queries. Version-controlled data pipelines.
technical-specialized.limitations: Steep learning curve for non-SQL users. Cloud pricing can escalate with usage. Requires existing data warehouse infrastructure.
